# coolify_tag (Resource)

A team-wide tag. Tags can be attached to applications, services and databases, and drive batch deployments via the `/deploy?tag=` API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "coolify_tag" "frontend" {
  name = "frontend"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Tag name (2 to 255 characters).

### Read-Only

- `uuid` (String) Server-assigned identifier.
